login.title: Staff sign in

errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account has been disabled. Contact your administrator.

password.title: Change password
password.forcedInfo: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own password to continue.
password.rules: At least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one number.

errors.PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: The new password must be different from the current one.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: The new password is too long.

roleInfo.SUPER_ADMIN: You manage user accounts and departments, and you can see every camp.
roleInfo.ORGANIZER: You create camps, share their QR codes and handle complaints for your camps.
roleInfo.MEDICAL_STAFF: You will see feedback and complaints for your department.
roleInfo.ANALYST: You will see combined, anonymous results across camps.

home.next: QR codes, the feedback form, complaints and dashboards will appear here as each phase is finished.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Staff accounts and what each person is allowed to do.

form.departmentHint: Medical staff only see feedback for their department.
form.noDepartments: No active departments. Add one on the Departments page first.
form.createHint: A temporary password will be created and shown once.

confirmDisable.title: Disable {{name}}?
confirmDisable.body: They are signed out straight away and cannot sign in until you enable the account again.

confirmReset.title: Reset the password for {{name}}?
confirmReset.body: A new temporary password is created. The old password stops working and the account is unlocked.

tempPassword.title: Temporary password
tempPassword.body: Give this password to {{name}}. It is shown only once. They must change it when they first sign in.

errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: A user with this email already exists.
errors.DEPARTMENT_REQUIRED: Medical staff must be linked to a department.
errors.DEPARTMENT_INACTIVE: This department is inactive. Choose another one.
errors.CANNOT_DISABLE_SELF: You cannot disable your own account.
errors.CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_ROLE: You cannot change your own role.

departments.title: Departments
departments.subtitle: Services offered at camps. Medical staff are linked to one department.
departments.name: Department name
departments.empty: No departments yet. Add the services your camps offer, such as Eye Care or Dental.

errors.DEPARTMENT_NAME_TAKEN: A department with this name already exists.

camps.title: Camps

subtitle.SUPER_ADMIN: Every medical camp, its services and whether feedback is open.
subtitle.MEDICAL_STAFF: Camps that offer a service of your department.

camps.searchPlaceholder: Search by camp name or location
camps.emptyCanCreate: No camps yet. Create your first camp, add its services, then start it when attendees can give feedback.

comingSoon.complaints: Complaints raised at this camp will appear here in a later update.

services.empty: No services yet. Attendees choose the service they used when they give feedback, so add at least one before starting the camp.

notice.notStarted: The camp is active, but the feedback window opens on {{opens}}.
notice.ended: The window closed on {{closes}}. Edit the camp to extend it, or close the camp.
notice.upcoming: Start the camp to open feedback. The window runs from {{opens}} to {{closes}}.
notice.closed: Feedback is closed because the camp is {{status}}.
notice.needsServices: Add at least one service before starting the camp.

closeConfirm.title: Close {{name}}?
closeConfirm.body: Attendees will no longer be able to give feedback. You can reopen the camp later.

archiveConfirm.title: Archive {{name}}?
archiveConfirm.body: Archived camps are hidden from the camp list and cannot be edited. You can restore them later.

actions.restoreDone: The camp is restored as Closed.

form.name: Camp name
form.namePlaceholder: For example: Rampur Eye and Dental Camp
form.organizerHint: The organizer manages this camp and its complaints.
form.noOrganizers: No active organizers. Add a user with the Organizer role first.
form.campDatesHint: Pick the first and last day. For a one-day camp, pick the same day twice.
form.feedbackWindowHint: Days when attendees can use the form while the camp is active. By default, until 7 days after the camp.
form.servicesHint: What the camp offers, with the department for each. Attendees pick one when they give feedback.
form.noServicesYet: No services yet. You can save now and add them later, but the camp cannot start without one.
form.noDepartments: No departments exist yet. Ask the Super Admin to add them.
form.noDepartmentsAdmin: No departments exist yet. Add them first on this page:
form.archivedBody: Archived camps cannot be edited. Restore the camp first.

validation.datesRequired: Pick the first and last day of the camp
validation.windowRequired: Pick when feedback opens and closes
validation.windowBeforeCamp: The feedback window cannot close before the camp starts
validation.tooManyServices: A camp can have up to 50 services

errors.INVALID_DATES: The end date must be on or after the start date.
errors.INVALID_FEEDBACK_WINDOW: The feedback window cannot close before it opens or before the camp starts.
errors.ORGANIZER_REQUIRED: Choose the organizer for this camp.
errors.ORGANIZER_INVALID: Choose an active user with the Organizer role.
errors.SERVICE_NAME_DUPLICATE: Two services have the same name. Give each one a different name.
errors.SERVICE_NOT_FOUND: One of the services was changed by someone else. Reload the page and try again.
errors.DEPARTMENT_INACTIVE: One of the chosen departments is inactive. Choose another one.
errors.CAMP_ARCHIVED: Archived camps cannot be edited. Restore the camp first.
errors.CAMP_HAS_NO_SERVICES: Add at least one service before starting the camp.
errors.INVALID_STATUS_CHANGE: This change is not allowed from the camp's current status. Reload the page.
errors.NOT_CAMP_ORGANIZER: Only this camp's organizer can change it.
errors.CAMP_ACCESS_DENIED: You do not have access to this camp.
errors.SERVICE_HAS_FEEDBACK: A service you removed already has feedback, so it must stay. You can rename it instead.

qr.localTitle: Phones cannot open this link yet
qr.localBody: The link points to this computer itself (localhost), which phones cannot reach. Start the app with the address phones use to reach this laptop, for example on the Windows hotspot:
qr.worksBeforeOpen: You can print the poster now. The link already works, but attendees can only give feedback while the camp is Active and inside its feedback window.
qr.linkHint: This is the link inside the QR code. Share it in a message for anyone who cannot scan.
qr.regenerateHint: If the link was shared where it should not be, make a new one. The old QR code and link stop working straight away, so print the poster again.

regenerateConfirm.title: Make a new link for this camp?
regenerateConfirm.body: Every printed poster and shared link for this camp will stop working. You will need to print the poster again.

qr.regenerated: New link created. Print the poster again.

poster.printHint: In the print window, choose A4 paper and turn off headers and footers. To keep a copy, choose "Save as PDF".
poster.noWifi: Tip: an admin can add the camp Wi-Fi under Settings, so attendees can join the hotspot by scanning too.

feedback.analystNote: Analysts see combined, anonymous results on the dashboards (coming in a later update), not individual feedback.
feedback.departmentOnly: You see feedback about your department's services only.
feedback.fillInHint: Helping someone without a phone? Open the form here and fill it in with them. It is marked as staff-assisted.
feedback.empty: No feedback yet. Share the camp's QR code to start collecting it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Feedback links and the camp Wi-Fi printed on posters.

links.title: Feedback links
links.body: QR codes and posters point to this address:
links.howToChange: To change it, start the app with APP_PUBLIC_BASE_URL set to the new address, for example http://192.168.137.1:8080 on the Windows hotspot.

wifi.title: Camp Wi-Fi
wifi.body: Printed on every poster as a second QR code, so attendees can join the hotspot by scanning instead of typing.
wifi.ssidHint: Exactly as shown in the hotspot settings, including capital letters.
wifi.passwordHint: 8 to 63 characters, as set on the hotspot.
wifi.passwordRule: Use 8 to 63 characters: English letters, numbers and symbols
wifi.nameTooLong: This network name is too long for Wi-Fi

clearConfirm.title: Remove the camp Wi-Fi?
clearConfirm.body: Posters printed from now on will show only the feedback QR code.

wifi.previewHint: Scan it with a phone to test it before printing.
wifi.notSet: No camp Wi-Fi set. Posters will show only the feedback QR code.

errors.WIFI_PASSWORD_INVALID: Use 8 to 63 characters: English letters, numbers and symbols.
errors.WIFI_NAME_TOO_LONG: This network name is too long for Wi-Fi.

poster.title: Tell us about your visit
poster.subtitle: Your feedback helps us improve this camp.
poster.typeLink: Or type this address in your phone's browser
poster.how1: Open your phone camera and point it at the code.
poster.how2: Tap the link that appears on the screen.
poster.how3: No app or account needed. It takes about 2 minutes.
poster.help: Need help? Ask any volunteer at the help desk.
poster.track: Reported a problem? Check it at

public.invalidBody: Please scan the QR code on the camp poster again, or ask a volunteer for help.
public.offlineBody: Check that your phone is connected to the camp Wi-Fi, then try again.
public.notStartedBody: This camp is not taking feedback yet. Please try again later.
public.endedBody: The feedback period for this camp has ended. Thank you for visiting.
public.notActiveBody: This camp is not taking feedback right now.

feedbackForm.privacy: Your feedback is anonymous unless you ask us to contact you. Please do not write medical details such as diagnoses or medicines.
feedbackForm.draftRestored: We kept the answers you started earlier.

ratings.title: How was your visit?
ratings.hint: Tap a face for each question. Questions marked * must be answered.

comment.title: Anything else to tell us?
comment.label: Your comments (optional)
comment.hint: Please do not include medical details such as diagnoses or medicines.
comment.placeholder: What went well? What could be better?

problem.label: I want to report a problem
problem.hint: Staff will look into it. You will get a reference number to check on it.
problem.categoryRequired: Please choose what the problem was about
problem.descriptionHint: Where and when, so staff can fix it. Please do not include medical details.
problem.descriptionShort: Please describe the problem in a few more words

followUp.title: Should we contact you about your feedback?
followUp.yes: Yes, I would like a reply
followUp.anonymousNote: We will not ask for your name or number.
followUp.name: Your name (optional)
followUp.email: Email (optional if you give a phone number)
followUp.consent: I agree that camp staff may contact me about this feedback. My details are used only for this.
followUp.consentRequired: Please tick this so we may contact you
followUp.contactRequired: Give a phone number or an email
followUp.invalidPhone: Enter a phone number with 7 to 15 digits

done.title: Thank you!
done.body: Your feedback has been received. It helps us make the camp better for everyone.
done.problemNote: Your problem has been passed on to the camp staff.

already.title: You have already given feedback
already.body: This phone has already sent feedback for this camp. Do you want to give feedback for someone else?

assisted.banner: Staff mode: {{name}} is filling in this form for an attendee. Read each question aloud and let them choose.

errors.TOO_MANY_SUBMISSIONS: Too many forms from this phone. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.FORM_CLOSED: This camp has stopped taking feedback.
errors.network: Could not send. Check that you are connected to the camp Wi-Fi and try again. Your answers are saved on this phone.
errors.other: Something went wrong while sending. Please try again.

reference.title: Your reference number
reference.screenshot: Take a screenshot or write it down. You need it to check on your problem later.

track.title: Check my complaint
track.subtitle: Enter the reference number you got after reporting a problem.
track.label: Reference number

IN_PROGRESS.title: Being looked into
IN_PROGRESS.body: Camp staff are working on it.

RESOLVED.title: Resolved
RESOLVED.body: Staff have dealt with the problem.

track.notFoundBody: Check the reference number and try again. It looks like MC-26-K7Q2XP.
track.tooMany: Too many checks from this phone. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
track.offline: Cannot reach the camp. Check that you are connected to the camp Wi-Fi and try again.
track.privacy: This page shows only the progress of a complaint. It never shows names or contact details.

errors.forbiddenBody: Your role does not give you access to this page.
errors.notFoundBody: This page does not exist. It may have moved, or the link may be wrong.
errors.CONCURRENT_UPDATE: Someone else changed this at the same time. Reload and try again.
